name: Google Merchant
description: Google Merchant helps businesses manage their product listings and reach more customers through Google Shopping. It allows you to upload and maintain product information, ensuring your products are visible to potential buyers.

events.d: Deletes a product from your Google Merchant Center account.
Adds a product to your Google Merchant account so customers can find it on Google Shopping.
Get the products in the selected Merchant Center account.
Update an existing product’s details in your Google Merchant account so the listing shows the latest information.
